description: This file defines a service for fetching course data from a Strapi backend, mapping it to a specific LMS course model, and providing a public interface to retrieve courses with optional category filtering. It includes utility functions for extracting course attributes such as images, prices, and categories, and handles fallback logic when fetching data from different endpoints.

methods.name: pickFirstText
methods.description: Selects the first non-empty string from a list of values.

methods.name: extractImageUrl
methods.description: Extracts the image URL from course attributes, checking multiple possible fields.

methods.name: extractPrice
methods.description: Extracts and converts the price from course attributes, handling nulls and non-finite numbers.

methods.name: extractCategory
methods.description: Determines the category of a course from various possible attribute fields and maps it to a curated category.

methods.name: mapStrapiItemToCourse
methods.description: Maps a raw Strapi API item to the LMS course model, extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: fetchStrapiCourses
methods.description: Fetches courses from Strapi API endpoints, with filtering by category and fallback logic.

methods.name: getCourses
methods.description: Public function to retrieve courses, using remote API if enabled, with category filtering.
